skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.name: Item Timers
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.descripti: Timers for HolyWorld special items acting on you: Stun (15 s, pearls and chorus blocked), Ice Wave, trap box, raid block, the Immortality rune and more. Read from your own effects, server messages and blocks around you. "?" marks a guess until the server's wording is confirmed. Other players' cooldowns are never tracked.
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.setting.c: Chat, titles and the action bar. Lines that look like player chat are skipped
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.setting.e: Recognise an item by its effect on you: Stun gives Slowness I for 15 s, Snow Lump Slowness 6, Jake's Lamp Glowing and a pumpkin on your head
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.setting.b: An ice sphere, a trap box, and obsidian broken by an explosion (raid block), from the server's block updates
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.setting.r: Show the raid block while you are within this many blocks of the blown-up obsidian
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.setting.n: A short line under each timer: what you cannot do now
skirmish.module.hw_item_timers.setting.h: On other servers words like "стан" mean something else
skirmish.hwtimers.timer.elements.note: Log out and your Elements drop
